title: Spotted Pod Borer on Pigeon Pea

Header: Spotted Pod Borer on Pigeon Pea
Maruca testulalis Vernacular name: Pulli kai Puzhu

Prevention: Optimum level of nitrogenous fertilizer as per soil testing recommendation.
Avoid closer sowing for erect varieties such as
Sunn hemp in the borders as it is an alternate host.
Follow crop rotation with non- host crops such as paddy, maize, etc.
Grow resistant varieties of pigeon pea e.g., ICPL-87119.
Monitoring: Monitor the pest by setting up light traps @ one per five hectare.
Look for presence of bore holes on the buds, flowers and pods.
Look for webbing of leaves, flowers and pods.
Direct Control: Erection of bird perches @ 15 numbers per hectare.
Application of azadirachtin 3 ml per litre of water at the onset of pest attack.
Restrictions: Apply insecticides in rotation on need basis to protect the pollinators since red gram is a highly cross pollinated crop.
Highly toxic to aquatic organisms, bees, birds and mammals
Systemic insecticide with contact and stomach action
